question: Padres vs. Mets — Who wins? (Aug 19)

model.prompt_context:

- "San Diego Padres": Wins if the San Diego Padres have a higher final score than the New York Mets at the conclusion of the August 19, 2026 MLB game played at Citi Field.
- "New York Mets": Wins if the New York Mets have a higher final score than the San Diego Padres at the conclusion of the August 19, 2026 MLB game played at Citi Field.

- The official final score is determined after all innings are completed, including any extra innings required to resolve a tie.
